name: ritueel-local-page
description: The local page of ritueel. Built in demo mode it is the demo on the site: an in-memory ConnectRPC transport answers from fixtures.

scripts.build:real: tsc --noEmit && RITUEEL_MODE=real BASE=./ OUT_DIR=dist-real vite build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:real && npm run check:dist
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && vitest run src/safety.test.ts
